description: Export the complete contents of the 'example-repo-local' repository to the server's local filesystem for backup purposes. Log in to Artifactory (admin/password). Navigate to the Administration module, find 'Import & Export', and select the 'Repositories' section. In the 'Export' tab, select 'example-repo-local' as the source repository. Set the Export Path to '/home/ga/repo_export'. Ensure 'Include Metadata' is checked. Click Export and wait for the operation to complete. The export directory must contain the repository artifacts and metadata.
